Visit note | 2025-03-23 02:00 PM | Dr. Shahadat Hossain, ENT | Patient: Sabina Akter, 24, female. Miss Akter comes in reporting a painful sore throat and difficulty swallowing. She is a pharmacist and mentions her symptoms began after an outbreak at a school in Banani. She lives in a shared mess in Uttara and works long shifts serving customers daily. She has no chronic medical conditions and reports no previous major illnesses. On examination, her temperature is 102.7°F, BP 117/78 mmHg, pulse 96 bpm, and weight 52 kg. Her throat is significantly erythematous with visible exudates on both tonsils, and tender anterior cervical lymphadenopathy is palpable. Chest is clear bilaterally and heart sounds are normal. Assessment: Acute tonsillitis. Plan: a prescription was issued for supportive and targeted treatment. She was advised to gargle with warm salt water, eat soft foods, and drink plenty of fluids to stay hydrated. Follow-up in 1 week if symptoms do not fully resolve.

Visit note | 2025-03-23 02:00 PM | Dr. Faisal Karim, Psychiatry | Patient: Mahiya Mahmud, 44, female. Mrs. Mahmud presents with complaints of persistent low energy, lack of interest in her usual daily activities, and poor sleep quality. She works as a bus driver in Dhaka and states her low mood started after the death of a parent in Jashore. She has no known comorbidities. She was advised to keep a daily routine, walk outdoors daily, and start counselling sessions. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-03-23 03:00 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Tahsin Miah, 50, female. Mrs. Miah reports poor appetite and a dull, constant discomfort in her abdomen.
